scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d --build postgres rabbitmq keycloak games wallets && docker compose up -d --force-recreate kong && docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate frontend
scripts.prisma:generate: cd services/games && bunx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma && cd ../wallets && bunx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate:games: cd services/games && bunx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate:wallets: cd services/wallets && bunx prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.check:games: bun run prisma:generate:games && cd services/games && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test tests/unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.check:wallets: bun run prisma:generate:wallets && cd services/wallets && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test tests/unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.check: bun run check:games && bun run check:wallets
scripts.check:frontend: cd frontend && bun run lint && bun run build
scripts.check:all: bun run check && bun run check:frontend
